items.title: In the months after a disappointing Finals series against the Knicks, De'Aaron Fox gave himself the gift of letting go.
items.author: Jeff McDonald
items.body_excerpt:
In the months after a disappointing Finals series against the Knicks, De'Aaron Fox gave himself the gift of letting go.

"It's a new day," Fox said.

The All-Star guard understands he can't erase what happened in June. He can only control what comes next.
